_comment: Tables in the EXE's data that were untyped bytes (2026-11-15): the control symbols, the DirectX error names, the text table of Text_WrapLines, the C runtime's _ctype and zlib's static literal tree.

structs.name: ControlSymbol
structs.comment: One input control of the engine (keys, mouse and joystick axes), g_aControlSymbols: system.controls maps its name to its index.
fields: 1 enabled (sputLua_NotifyControlHandlers reports it), 4 a key (else an axis), 8 axis inverted
the key (DirectInput scan code) or axis stdControl_ReadKey / stdControl_ReadAxis takes
an axis's last value reported to system.axisHandler (float bits)

structs.name: DxErrorName
structs.comment: HRESULT and its name (the DirectDraw and Direct3D error tables).
